Enterprise Cloud Architect
Microsoft
Hyderabad, Telangana, India (Hybrid)

About the Role:
Lead enterprise architecture strategy for Azure cloud data platforms across APAC.

Responsibilities:
• Architect distributed systems, microservices, and hybrid cloud solutions.
• Advise enterprise clients on system design, scalability, and security best practices.
• Partner with global engineering teams to drive product improvements.

Requirements:
• 8+ years of software architecture and cloud engineering experience.
• Master of Technology (M.Tech) or MS preferred.
• Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, cloud, and Kubernetes.
